Console output helpers

Source: R/utils-messages.R
inform_if.Rd

Internal helpers for messages and printed reports.

Usage

inform_if(verbose, ...)

print_lines(x, ...)

cli_duplicate_ids_footer(x)

Arguments

verbose

Logical. Whether to emit the message.

...

Passed to rlang::inform() (for inform_if()) or to print() (for print_lines()).

x

For print_lines(), any printable object; for cli_duplicate_ids_footer(), an essence_dup_summary or essence_dup_classified object.

Value

inform_if() returns NULL invisibly. print_lines() returns a character vector. cli_duplicate_ids_footer() is called for its cli output side effect.

Details

inform_if() emits an rlang::inform() message only when verbose is TRUE. It gates informational (non-fatal, non-warning) messages in functions that have a verbose argument; rlang::warn() and rlang::abort() calls never go through it and always fire.

print_lines() returns the lines print(x, ...) would write as a character vector, so a format() method can embed them with cli::cli_verbatim().

cli_duplicate_ids_footer() renders the identical "Duplicated Visit IDs" footer shared by the format() methods of essence_dup_summary and essence_dup_classified objects. It must be called inside cli::cli_format_method().
